part1.intro: The examiner asks you about yourself, your home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Flowers and plants
questions: Do you have a favourite flower or plant? [Why/Why not?]
What kinds of flowers and plants grow near where you live? [Why/Why not?]
Is it important to you to have flowers and plants in your home? [Why/Why not?]
Have you ever bought flowers for someone else? [Why/Why not?]

part2.topic: Describe a review you read about a product or service.
points: what the product or service was
what information the review gave about the product or service
part2.closing: and explain what you did as a result of reading this review.

topics.title: Online reviews
questions: What kinds of things do people write online reviews about in your country?
Why do some people write online reviews?
Do you think that online reviews are good for both shoppers and companies?

topics.title: Customer service
questions: What do you think it might be like to work in a customer service job?
Do you agree that customers are more likely to complain nowadays?
How important is it for companies to take all customer complaints seriously?
